title: Tesla and SpaceX discussing potential merger
excerpt: Tesla and SpaceX have formed special independent committees to discuss a potential merger between the two companies, according to Elon Musk.
body_html:
Tesla and SpaceX are exploring a potential merger following requests from shareholders, according to remarks made by Elon Musk during an earnings call. Special committees consisting of independent directors have been established at both companies to discuss the matter.

Musk, who acts as the chief executive officer for both organizations, did not disclose the names of the independent directors serving on these committees during the third-quarter earnings call on Tuesday.
